description: React component for user login page with organization selection, handling authentication, organization fetching, and navigation.

methods.name: handleFindOrgs
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with the entered email and auto-selects 'Kavia B2C' if available.

methods.name: handleOrganizationSelect
methods.description: Handles manual selection of organization from dropdown, logs selected org info.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login with selected organization, email, and password, handles errors, and redirects on success.
